question:
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series?

188 170 152 134 116 ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Observe the pattern of the series: it is a decreasing series.

The difference between consecutive terms is constant.

Common difference = 188 − 170 = 18.

Applying the same logic to the last term: 116 − 18 = 98.

**∴ The correct answer is 98.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

The pattern follows a constant subtraction of 18 from each preceding number.

⇒ 188 − 18 = 170

⇒ 170 − 18 = 152

⇒ 152 − 18 = 134

⇒ 134 − 18 = 116

⇒ 116 − 18 = 98

**∴ The correct answer is 98.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Arithmetic Progression (AP) Series

A sequence where the difference between any two consecutive terms is constant, known as the common difference (d).

General Term of AP

The nth term can be calculated using the formula: aₙ = a₁ + (n − 1)d, where a₁ is the first term.

Decreasing Number Series

In a decreasing series, the common difference is negative (d < 0), meaning each subsequent term is smaller than the previous one.</p
